facts.fact: The Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT page says a GIZ-funded pilot, run with the Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Resources and the Rwanda Space Agency from 15 November 2024 to 1 September 2025 in four districts, is developing an automated satellite-based crop mapping system to integrate with AMIS and SAS.

systems.owner: Alliance Bioversity-CIAT with MinAgri and Rwanda Space Agency
